Agreed 2026-09-05:
• Restore = overlay (keeps files not in the backup), with an 'Exact restore' checkbox that adds type-to-confirm.
• No in-app archive browser in v1 — 'Open Folder' instead; browser comes next.
• Backup location fixed at ~/Seabass Backups/, with 'Change Location…' here and in App Settings.
Card icons drawn as line SVG here; the real ActionCards use Noto Sans Symbols glyphs — pick one when the card is built.

Restore lives top-level (next to Format USB Stick) because the per-stick card grid only shows for recognised DJ sticks — a blank replacement stick would never reach it. The per-stick page's 'Restore Onto Stick…' pushes this same page with the drive preselected.
